articles.title: Artemis astronauts send down Easter message, prep for lunar fly around Monday
articles.summary: Taking time out to send Easter greetings down to Earth, the four Artemis II astronauts closed in on the moon Sunday, already seeing unexpected detail on the surface and giving scientists a taste of things to come during a pass over the lunar far side Monday evening.
